en: A color image of a small-town central square with a landscaped park in the foreground, featuring paths, lawns, flowerbeds, and a white statue on a pedestal. Around the square are low, tiled-roof buildings and two-story houses with balconies, surrounded by trees and greenery. In the background, forested hills and mountains are visible under a clear sky. A few people are walking or standing in the open paved area.
